title: docs(adr): ADR-0131 D6 charts sharing_rule under regime O, guarded, and reads the activation ledger one way (ruling B′ on #24378)
body:
Filing gate **③**: a task the maintainer directed. Decision #24378 was ruled **B′**: 「同意」 then 「B′」, recorded verbatim by the director seat at 6257388265. Reader who acts: the epic seat (`epic:#15194`) dispatches it; the maintainer merges (Tier H, governed ADR text). Dedupe: semantic search on objectstack, "sharing rule regime O overlay guard … reconcile shadowed grants" → 24 results, none a carrier: the nearest are the decision card itself and stage 9, both closed.

## What the ruling binds (verbatim items 1 and 5 of 6257388265)

> **The chart.** ADR-0131 D6 lists `sharing_rule` under regime O (overlay): a stored `sys_sharing_rule` row of the declared rule's name, in its scope, replaces the declared rule whole; `active: false` on that row is the switch-off; the ownership ceremony deletes only uncustomised mirrors (the #2909 promise, `sharing-plugin.ts:852`–`:857`, stands). One dated line, Tier H (the maintainer merges). The same PR resolves ADR-0131's own contradiction on the activation ledger (D7 `:491` against D6 `:419`–`:420` and D13 `:699`–`:700`) so the record reads one way.

> **Nothing else:** no activation-ledger type for sharing rules (A), no blanket refusal of same-name rows (C), nothing left as is (D).

## Wanted

One docs PR on `docs/adr/0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md`:
- **D6 gains one dated line** charting `sharing_rule` under regime O, guarded. It names the guard and the immediate reconcile; both are built by the companion code card.
- **The activation-ledger contradiction gets one reading.** D7 at about `:491` disagrees with D6 at about `:419`–`:420` and with D13 at about `:699`–`:700`. The PR resolves it with dated notes, ⛔ never by rewriting the ruled text.
- No code. ⛔ Nothing under `content/docs/releases/`.

## Acceptance

- The ADR states one reading of each point, with the ruling cited by its comment id.
- The PR carries an at-tier `## Contract review` record (governed rules text) and is merged by the maintainer.
